timeline.event: Jun obeys Shiki's urgent request, sends urgent highest-priority medical dispatch for adult male, conscious, severe neuromuscular weakness with shallow breathing, low SpO2 93% while oxygen supplied. Request respiratory support-equipped evacuation team. He does not automatically send Shiki to any place or act for him.

Patient attempts to speak, Shiki tells him not now, preserving life primary. Patient visually fixes on Shiki's unsettling controlled face, stops speaking effort, shows visible tears without assigned emotional interpretation. Tiyo obeys guarded conveyance decision but anxiously offers advice about pump/oxygen circuits; Jun allows her to remain under observation, says she cannot switch medical equipment herself. Broken-nose escort appears tense, glances toward Tiyo and Shiki, Jun orders escort held separately to avoid contact.

By Shiki's order Kusa officers return container to ORIGINAL transport mode. Critically before lid sealed: Tiyo under guard identifies air intake/outlet, local medic checks oxygen line and ventilatory exhaust port/valves for clearance, leaves unlabelled IV running unchanged. Container closure leaves functioning oxygen delivery/airflow and medical connections, not airtight suffocation. Thermal regulator re-engages. Monitoring via viewing panel SpO2 93->94%, RR remains high; no abrupt deterioration immediately. No additional medical chakra or player action.

Secure station relay confirms Kusa Central Hospital RECEIVED medical emergency, dispatches equipped team for breathing support and litter transfer. On-scene Jun relays unknown IV agent and patient current function, staff require supplemental oxygen continuation and all known drug information. MEDICAL TEAM HAS NOT YET ARRIVED. South-post reinforcements support detention and evidence collection. The 10 convoy persons remain legally held at checkpoint; seized weapons inventoried. Med patient, Shiki and Tiyo with guards planned for hospital; others/cargo remain checkpoint pending investigation.

South patrol reports one guard carrying sealed official communication scroll, not opened and no proven attempted communication; will be handled by investigator/protocol. It may be routine or alert network, unknown.

With case closed, awake male visible through viewing port watches Shiki, weak finger motion, no more knocking. Tiyo, under guard, unexpectedly volunteers: she does not know patient name, told not to ask; he is not first person she transported, she has been on the route 8 months and claims eleven transfers. No corroboration yet, content and number of others unknown. Jun asks how many, Tiyo states 11 and stops, biting inside cheek. Medics still en route. Await player response or arrival through time advance if user indicates.
